name: VWAP false breakout
idea: Within one session, the market crosses to one side of the session VWAP and holds there for a while, then the close comes back through VWAP: the move failed. The idea is wrong beyond the session extreme since the cross, or VWAP with a buffer.

params.label: Bars looked back
params.help: The bars before the cross-back in which the time on the other side of VWAP is counted. Reference: 9 on the 5-minute chart (about 45 minutes).

params.label: Bars held on the other side
params.help: Of those bars, at least this many closed on the other side of VWAP. Reference: 6 on the 5-minute chart (about 30 minutes).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The session extreme since the market crossed to the other side of VWAP, or VWAP with a buffer.
choice_labels: The session extreme since the cross

params.label: ATR period
params.help: The bars of the average true range the distances and buffers are measured in.

params.label: VWAP buffer
params.help: For 'VWAP with a buffer': how many average true ranges beyond VWAP.

constraints.message: The bars held on the other side cannot be more than the bars looked back.

trigger.long: CrossAbove(close, SessionVWAP()) AND Count($bars_n, close < SessionVWAP())[1] >= $bars_min
trigger.short: CrossBelow(close, SessionVWAP()) AND Count($bars_n, close > SessionVWAP())[1] >= $bars_min
